dedupe_keys.name: energiesprong industrialised net zero whole house retrofit in europe

description: Energiesprong is a whole-house refurbishment and new-build approach, started in the Netherlands in 2010, that aims for net-zero energy homes no longer relying on fossil gas. Renovations use super-insulated prefabricated facades to maximise efficiency and renewable technologies so each home generates as much energy as its occupants need, with a share of the renovation cost repaid from energy bill savings under a long-term performance guarantee. The alliance works through market development teams in France, Germany, the UK and Italy that bring building owners, residents, companies, governments and financiers together to pilot solutions, industrialise components and build business models; recent project names on the site include Circular Reno, Cosme Reno and Giga Regio Factory. Coverage: the Netherlands, the UK, France, Germany and Italy, with more than 10,000 homes reported. Access: programme pages, country pages and news on the Energiesprong website. Licence: website content, no licence stated; free to read. Caveats: the site gives headline counts but no project-level performance data, so energy results must be sought from national teams or project reports. Simulation uses are as a reference case for industrialised deep retrofit, performance-guaranteed financing and building stock decarbonisation scenarios. Related records: the EP0 energy poverty district retrofit tool.
